ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\triangle ABC \cong \triangle DEF$, $BC=7$, and $EC=4$, then what is the length of $CF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ABC \cong \triangle DEF$,\\
it follows that $BC = EF = 7$,\\
hence $CF = EF - EC = 7 - 4 = \boxed{3}$.
